description: This PHP script defines a class ViewPopup that extends SugarView, associated with rendering a popup interface in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM platform. It handles loading metadata, list view definitions, search definitions, and rendering a popup or a picker based on the context.

classes.name: ViewPopup
classes.description: A class extending SugarView responsible for rendering a popup window in the SuiteCRM platform with dynamic loading of metadata, view definitions, and search definitions; handling permissions; and rendering either a list-based popup or a picker.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent SugarView constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method responsible for processing request parameters, loading metadata and view definitions, managing permissions, initializing popup display, and rendering it. It handles both list view popup rendering and generic popup picker.
